examples.explanation: The robot starts at (0, 0): Move north 4 units to (0, 4). Turn right. Move east 3 units to (3, 4). The furthest point the robot ever gets from the origin is (3, 4), which squared is 32 + 42 = 25 units away.

The robot starts at (0, 0): Move north 4 units to (0, 4). Turn right. Move east 1 unit and get blocked by the obstacle at (2, 4), robot is at (1, 4). Turn left. Move north 4 units to (1, 8). The furthest point the robot ever gets from the origin is (1, 8), which squared is 12 + 82 = 65 units away.

The robot starts at (0, 0): Move north 6 units to (0, 6). Turn right. Turn right. Move south 5 units and get blocked by the obstacle at (0,0), robot is at (0, 1). The furthest point the robot ever gets from the origin is (0, 6), which squared is 62 = 36 units away.
